spans.s: 1. अर्ज् अर्ज्, i. 1, and 10, Par. To earn, to acquire,

(Ātm.).
 स्व-अर्जित and स्वयम्-अर्जित, adj. Acquired by one's own efforts,

.
 --With the prep. उप उप, To acquire,

2. अर्ज् अर्ज्, i. 10, Par. To work, to prepare.
 --With the prepositions समुप सम्-उप, To prepare,
अर्ज् + अन, n. Earning, acquisition, Böhtl. Ind.

अर्ज्-उन (from a lost vb. akin to राज्).
 I. adj., f. नी, White,

= Rigv. i. 49, 3.
 II. m.
 1. A tree, Terminalia Arjuna,
. The name of the third son of Pāṇḍu,

.
 --Cf. ἀργεννός, ἄργυρος; Lat. argentum; the base of these forms is अर्ज् + वन्त्: cf. also ἀργός, ἄργιλος, ἀργής, Ἀργυννίς; see रञ्ज्, रजत.
आर्जव, i. e. ऋजु + अ, n. Candour, []
आर्जुनेय, i. e. अर्जुन + एय, patronym. m. A descendant of Arjuna (?),
